data.body: Patch set 2 changes the skip rule after LLM-Review -1 on 3500: the reducer resolves forked STATUS chains by smallest UUID, so 'latest STATUS' in collection order can disagree with it. A raising ticket is now skipped only when every event parsed and no STATUS event ever set closed; any close in the history (including closed-then-reopened) means it is judged. A reopened ticket that cannot be reduced therefore fails an enforcing gate; that is the intended fail-closed trade-off. New tests: test_unreadable_ticket_with_any_close_in_history_is_judged, test_one_compacted_event_makes_an_unreadable_ticket_judged (pins the compaction short-circuit).
